strings.new:
Create a circular display of ink that blocks vision and grants allies {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Spirit'}.

Enemies inside are revealed, and leaving causes them to take {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} and suffer from {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Silence'} and {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Slow'}, destroying the ink in the process.

On Buff: +{s:AbilityLifestealPercentHero}% Spirit Lifesteal
+{s:TechPower} Spirit Power

+{s:SilenceDuration}s Silence Duration
+{s:AbilityDuration}s Ability Duration
Ink is no longer destroyed

Empower ({g:citadel_binding:'ABILITY1'}): Your next 3 bullets come to life, allowing you to steer them as they travel. The bullets deal increased {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'BulletDamage'} and splash {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} in a small area.

Each successful hit against a hero reduces all ability cooldowns, and half for all item cooldowns.

Draw ({g:citadel_binding:'ADS'}): Paint a solid stroke of ink instead that blocks projectiles and characters from passing through.

The stroke can be destroyed with a heavy melee, but deals {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} to the attacker.
Passive: Casting any other ability refreshes the cooldown of Flow State.
On Empower: Gain +{s:BonusFireRatePerStack}% Fire Rate for {s:StackDuration}s, stacking {s:MaxStacks} times

Drag a brush that continues to travel forward, leaving a trail that grants bonus slide distance for allies and a fading {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Slow'} and {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} to enemies it passes through, increased the further it travels.

Re-activate the ability to flick the brush forward, ending the ability early but dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'} in a larger area.
On Slide: Gain Damage Amp over time, up to {s:OutgoingDamagePercent}% for {s:DamageAmpDuration}s

Choose a hero to be your subject, dealing {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDPS'} as long as you are looking at them.

If the sketch is completed they take additional {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'}, suffer from {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Stun'}, and drop a sketch that can be picked up.

For each collected sketch, you permanently gain stats based on the hero.
On Cast: Gain {s:HealthRegen} Health Regen for {s:BuffDuration}s, refreshed on pickup

strings.old:
Promote an ally to be a knight, granting bonus stamina and {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'CombatBarrier'} for a duration.

If self-cast you develop yourself as king instead, granting double the {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'CombatBarrier'} but no stamina.

Move ({g:citadel_binding:'ADS'}): Moves the piece, making it invulnerable during the duration before landing.
strings.new:
Promote an ally to be a knight, granting bonus stamina and {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'CombatBarrier'} for a duration.

If self-cast you develop yourself as king instead, granting double the {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'CombatBarrier'} but no stamina.

Move ({g:citadel_binding:'ADS'}): Moves the piece, making it invulnerable during the duration before landing. If self-cast, re-activate the ability to move instead.

Violet immigrated to The Cursed Apple when she was 12, and while there was a certain amount of culture shock to adapting to New York, she quickly fell in love with the vibrance of the city.   Dedicating herself to the pursuit of the arts, Violet's passion lead her to successes far beyond most of her peers.

First, a full ride to art school.

Then in her junior year, inclusion in MOMA'S prestigious celebration of student artists: \"The Upstart Gallery\".

By any measure she's doing phenomenal for her age, however Violet has not been able shake her existential dread of dying a failure. She knows that commercial success as a fine artist isn't about being good enough. It's not even about being great. It's about being seen by the right person at the right time.  And so she has set her sights on The Ritual... not to embellish on her own talent, but just to have a chance to show the world what she can do.
Hold {g:citadel_binding:'AbilityMelee'} to break with heavy melee
